text.6:135: Say (O Muhammad): O my people! Work according to your power. Lo! I too am working. Thus ye will come to know for which of us will be the happy sequel. Lo! the wrong-doers will not be successful.
text.11:93: And, O my people! Act according to your power, lo! I (too) am acting. Ye will soon know on whom there cometh a doom that will abase him, and who it is that lieth. And watch! Lo! I am a watcher with you.
text.11:121: And say unto those who believe not: Act according to your power. Lo! We (too) are acting.
text.36:67: And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place, making them powerless to go forward or turn back.
text.39:39: Say: O my people! Act in your manner. Lo! I (too) am acting. Thus ye will come to know
